messages:
Emma (eng-platform): Quick sync — STO2 region preflight. We're planning an incremental cutover next Tue 08:00 UTC. Need ownership confirmations for ingress, egress, KMS, DB replicas, routing policy. Please ack and call out blockers.

Priya (cloud-infra): I can own private control plane + KMS. Note: KMS key policy needs legal signoff (access principals). Pinging @Rebecca for confirmation.

Luis (network): Egress peering is provisioned but waiting on partner account acceptance (ticket #INC-9812). ETA today 18:00 UTC. DNS prep complete, will set low TTL during cutover.

Jason (eng-sre): I can own the canary run + incident triage. What's the canary percentage and healthcheck URL?

Emma (eng-platform): Canary plan: start at 1% -> 5% over 30m, rollback on 4xx spike or p95 latency > 500ms. Healthcheck: GET /_health/infra -> 200. I'll upload canary config to the console.

Emma (eng-platform): snippet for routing rule i'm going to push:
```yaml
routes:
  - match: /v1/*
    weighted_backends:
      - backend: sto2
        weight: 1
```

Sam (eng-oncall): Oncall window ok for that time. Need alert thresholds: p95 > 450ms and error rate > 0.5% to page. Also add synthetic check from EU region.

Rebecca (product): Legal flagged audit-log retention — we need 1yr retention for residency. Is that compatible with current logging backend in STO2? Also experiments team requests a feature flag for the rollout.

Priya (cloud-infra): Logging: yes, can route audit logs to EU S3 bucket with KMS encryption. Will confirm retention policy and update IAM. Feature flag: we can gate via console toggle, please create the toggle in the rollout plan.

Jason (eng-sre): DB replica status: staging replica lag 0-50ms. Production replica build is queued; promotion playbook needs to be documented. I'll open a PR with runbook. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4123

Luis (network): DNS TTLs set to 60s for fast failover. Firewall egress ACL still needs one more approval from security (sec-team). Ticket created: SEC-2345.

Priya (cloud-infra): KMS note: for STO2 we'll use HSM-backed key. That requires key rotation schedule — I'll plan rotation outside the cutover window and add to runbook.

Sam (eng-oncall): Who's primary pager for the cutover? I'll be secondary.

Emma (eng-platform): Jason primary, Sam secondary. I'll be on-call for rollout coordination. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created: job/sto2-canary-20260325T08:00Z. Status: pending approval.

Jason (eng-sre): I'll take the PR and runbook today, will post checklist when ready.

Emma (eng-platform): Blockers summary: 1) partner peering acceptance (Luis) 2) security ACL approval (Luis) 3) legal signoff on KMS policy (Rebecca). If these are cleared by EOD, we'll mark STO2 ready. Anyone else with blockers? :eyes:

Luis (network): Partner acceptance should land today, SEC-2345 is with SecOps, pinging them now.

Rebecca (product): Legal will review KMS policy this afternoon, will update here.

Priya (cloud-infra): No other infra blockers from my side.

Emma (eng-platform): Thanks everyone — I'll update the readiness doc and close the loop by 18:00 UTC. If anything changes, post here or DM.
